paragraphs: Our class is planning a spring fair at the town hall. The teacher {{mask_1}} is helping us has a big box of paint. We invited a farmer {{mask_2}} grows apples near our town. He will bring fruit from his farm. The hall {{mask_3}} the fair will take place has a garden. We will put the fruit on a table {{mask_4}} stands by the door. A baker {{mask_5}} cakes are popular in town will bring something sweet.

On the day, a musician {{mask_6}} lives next door will play the guitar. She has written a song {{mask_7}} tells a story about our town. We will have a game {{mask_8}} uses beanbags, too. Families can sit in a room {{mask_9}} looks out over the garden. At the end, we will thank the neighbors {{mask_10}} helped us get everything ready.
